name: KDT IDC Namwon Center
notes: Company data-center page lists Namwon Center as an upcoming GPU Dedicated Center with 2028 H1 RFS; no MW capacity disclosed.

name: Wanju AI Data Center
developer: Techno Green with LG Electronics and KEPCO KDN
notes: MOU-backed project in Wanju Techno Valley Industrial Complex; KEPCO KDN says first stage is 20MW facility supply capacity / 12MW IT load, expandable to 40MW; Yonhap reports 2028 buildout and 2029 H1 operating target.

name: North Jeolla Province Data Center Project
developer: Aedan Looking Glass for Turnkey Capital Inc.
notes: DCD reports ALG signed a purchase and sale agreement for a 200MW Wanju County data center and was conducting due diligence, hoping to break ground in coming months.

name: Korea Health and Medical Data Center Project
notes: Investment agreement for a 741.4 billion KRW data center on 55,642 sq m at San 41-3, Samman-ri, Damyang-eup; described as health, medical, telecom, and finance data integration. No public MW capacity found.

name: Gangjin Beneforce AI Data Center
developer: Benefos consortium with Daewoo E&C, KT, Top Solar, KG Engineering, IPA, Eugene Investment & Securities, Seed Investment Asset Management
notes: Gangjin County and Jeollanam-do signed an MOU for a 3.3 trillion KRW / 300MW AI data center, with operations targeted in 2029; later coverage says permitting was underway with groundbreaking targeted the following year.

name: SDN Gangjin Industrial Complex AI Data Center
developer: SDN with Gangjin County and Huawei advisory/tenant support
notes: SDN announced a first-phase roughly 120MW AI data center at/using its Gangjin Industrial Complex land and power infrastructure, with UPS and liquid-cooling supply ambitions; treated as separate from the Seongjeon-myeon Beneforce project.

name: Jeonnam Goheung Smart Farm Innovation Valley Big Data Center
developer: Goheung-gun Smart Farm Office; operated with Sunchon National University
notes: Specialized agricultural big-data center inside the Smart Farm Innovation Valley support center; official page lists purpose as collecting/analyzing environment and crop-growth data. Included as an operational sector-specific data center, not a hyperscale/colo facility.
